text:
Maria K: Quick sync — Evora interview went well and they've approved a short quote + summarized perf claim. Need to finalize: 1) short launch post, 2) a gated webinar, 3) benchmark visual, 4) SDR handoff for inbound leads. Assets target: next Wed.

Jonah P: Love it. My proposal: one long-form launch post (800-1k words), a 3-slide benchmark visual, a 60s customer clip for socials, and a 30-min webinar with a short Q&A.

Maria K: That maps to our playbook. Can you sketch a two-slide benchmark summary (vis + caption) and a 1-line social hook?

Jonah P: Sure. Draft social hook: "Evora scaled inference throughput ~3x while cutting per-inference cost up to 60% after moving to Redwood Dedicated." I'll add variants.

Selina L: Legal note: Evora asked we avoid publishing raw tail-latency p95s. They gave us permission for a summarized claim: "~3x throughput and up to 60% lower inference cost vs. prior setup." They also want the product name in parentheses: "Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity)" in the quote. I'll prepare the sign-off paragraph.

Priya R: Confirmed with Evora PM — they prefer the phrasing Jonah used but want "up to 60%" inserted. Also request: a short quote release email (one paragraph) that they can forward to legal.

Maria K: OK Selina — can you get the signed release back by Friday so we can keep timeline? If legal pushes, we move launch back one week.

Selina L: I'll send the release doc now and ask for an email sign-off. If they insist on alternate phrasing, we can use "customer-reported improvements" language.

deploy-bot: Recording created:
- Title: Evora customer interview
- When: 2024-06-12 14:00 PT
- Link: https://meet.company/evora-interview

Jonah P: I'll make a simple PNG + slide deck and upload to /marketing/evora-assets. Also creating a 60s clip script for the customer to approve: intro, challenge, result, CTA.

Tom S: For SDR handoff: we need a clear payload for the webhook. Suggest payload keys: id, email, company, lead_source, campaign, interest_tags. Example: {"id":"<uuid>","email":"<addr>","company":"<org>","lead_source":"webinar_evora","campaign":"evora_launch","interest_tags":["dedicated","benchmark"]}. Also: tag priority=enterprise when detection rules match.

Maria K: Good — Tom, please include preferred_demo=invite-only in the payload. Evora prefers invite-only demos first two weeks.

Tom S: Will do. I'll set up an invite-only registration flow: gated page -> registration -> manual approval for invites (SDR review). Also create an auto-tag for webinar registrants: "evora-webinar-reg".

Jonah P: Social plan: a 60s clip, a 15s cut for Twitter/X, and 2 quote cards for LinkedIn. I'll add alt text for accessibility.

Selina L: Redline request from Evora legal: add the release line: "Evora Inc. grants Redwood permission to use the above quote and high-level performance summary for marketing and benchmarking materials." They also want the date of approval on the release.

Maria K: Fine. Jonah, update slide caption to include source attribution line: "Customer reported results; configurations vary."

Priya R: Scheduling note: Evora would like a Monday launch to coincide with their product cycle. Proposed date: 2024-06-24. Legal wants signed release by 2024-06-14 to meet that.

Maria K: Put tentative embargo for assets and social until 2024-06-24. We'll send an embargoed copy to press list on the morning of the launch.

Tom S: Regarding lead flows: once release is signed and post goes live, route immediate inbound MQLs to SDR queue "evora-launch". For invite demo requests mark preferred_demo=invite-only and set nurture cadence: 3 emails over two weeks.

Jonah P: Uploaded first-pass assets: drive.google.com/evora/assets (png + pptx + clip-script).

Selina L: Evora legal replied: they approved the release with one tweak — change "Redwood Dedicated" -> "Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity)" inside the quote. They've attached a signed PDF.

Maria K: Got the PDF. Thanks Selina. Jonah — can you update the quote card text to the final approved wording?

Jonah P: Done. Updated PNG and social copy. Also exported a 60s clip transcript for captioning.

Tom S: SDR webhook ready. I'll run a smoke test using a dummy lead and tag priority=enterprise to confirm routing.

Maria K: Smoke test schedule: Tom run the test tomorrow at 11am PT. Jonah  put final assets in /marketing/playbooks/evora-launch/ and link in the playbook.

Priya R: Customer follow-up: Evora asked we share the webinar attendee list (names + titles) after we publish. Confirmed we will provide aggregate metrics but not internal logs.

Selina L: All legal items closed. Signed release in shared drive: /legal/evora-releases/evora_release_signed_20240613.pdf

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: Send embargo reminder 2024-06-23 09:00 PT to #marketing and #sales.

Maria K: Final action list: Jonah - final assets + 60s clip by Monday. Selina - secure signed release (done). Tom - configure SDR webhook + invite flow (smoke test tomorrow). I'll draft the launch blog and webinar invite. Thanks team! :rocket:
